focus: ETF previous-close NAV versus intraday indicative NAV and actual executable arbitrage distinction

hypotheses.claim: Stale daily NAV can manufacture apparent premium.
hypotheses.support: TWSE publishes separate daily NAV and intraday indicative NAV channels.
hypotheses.falsify: Price 102 vs old NAV 100 gives +2%; aligned indicative NAV 102 gives 0%.
hypotheses.alternative: Real premium, underlying move, quote lag.

hypotheses.claim: Aligned indicative gap may describe market conditions, not guaranteed AP arbitrage.
hypotheses.support: Primary creation/redemption and market making facilitate convergence.
hypotheses.falsify: Spread, fees, inventory, borrow cost, substitutions, settlement and market closure can block execution.
hypotheses.alternative: Stale underlying, FX, index event, dealer inventory.
hypotheses.failure: No executable bid/ask and AP receipts.

hypotheses.claim: ETF premium, unit changes and SBL can share economic roots.
hypotheses.support: Delivery demand may interact with borrowing.
hypotheses.falsify: Borrowing not necessarily short selling; secondary turnover not creation.

hypotheses.claim: Clock-valid research is not predictive evidence.
hypotheses.support: Prospective captures allow future OOS tests.
hypotheses.falsify: Price-volume, institutional flow, liquidity, index and regime may explain results.
hypotheses.failure: No preregistered common-support, walk-forward, purge, multiple-test and cost controls.

rules.clock: Require sourceAsOf, observedAt, firstKnownAt, decisionAt and matched reference type; synthetic strict same-clock policy is not official latency standard.
rules.output: PREVIOUS_NAV => descriptive only; aligned INAV => reference gap only; no actual AP execution inference.
rules.dedup: One primitive many consumers counts once; distinct sources sharing economic event not independent votes.
rules.borrow: True utilization UNKNOWN without lendable inventory denominator.
rules.validation: Preregister OOS walk-forward with purge/date clustering, multiplicity, liquidity, impact/fees, regime and redundancy.

next: Reconcile unmerged PF045/044 and local PF043, then capture real future same-clock price/indicative-NAV and units/PCF vintages; obtain D16 OOS protocol, and continue margin/SBL paired versions.
